text: {lead} lofts the bowl clear over the hedge and the bale makes a fine step. You scramble over after it, picking out the odd twig.
You go back over the bale, and {lead} lofts the bowl after you. A passing cyclist nods, as if this is normal.
A molehill, freshly heaped. {lead} drums a gentle rhythm on the ground and the worms come up to see what the fuss is. Among the soil: a purse, a bit damp.
